epics.title: Workspace Foundation, /.kiro Specs, Steering & Security Hooks
epics.summary: Establish the Go + TypeScript monorepo baseline, MIT license, committed /.kiro directory, automated prose and PBT hooks, secret redaction, and single GitHub contributor identity enforcement.

issues.title: Bootstrap Go + TypeScript monorepo, MIT LICENSE and non ignoring .gitignore
issues.problem: EchoLoom needs a reproducible Go 1.27 + Bun/TypeScript project baseline with a GitHub detectable MIT license and strict .gitignore rules that never exclude /.kiro.
issues.desiredBehavior: Repository builds both Go core packages and TypeScript MCP/UI packages cleanly while preserving /.kiro/{specs,hooks,steering} in git history.
acceptanceCriteria: Add MIT LICENSE naming harrymove-ctrl at project root.
Pin Go 1.27 and Node 24.x / Bun >= 1.4 toolchain manifests.
Configure .gitignore to exclude SQLite DBs and .env secrets while never matching .kiro.
issues.verification: git check-ignore -v .kiro exits with no match and toolchain version check succeeds.

issues.title: Author Kiro Crew specs, steering docs, custom agents and automated hooks
issues.problem: Kiroween evaluation scores depth across Kiro specs, steering documents, hooks, and multi agent Kiro Crew role separation.
issues.desiredBehavior: Committed /.kiro specs, steering guides, and hooks automate zero dash prose linting, PBT runs, and 4 role crew workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: Write canonical requirements, design, and task specs in /.kiro/specs/.
Write product, technical, and security steering docs in /.kiro/steering/.
Define prose linter, PBT trigger, and .kiro guard hooks in /.kiro/hooks/hooks.json.
issues.verification: node scripts/check-prose.mjs passes with zero violations across all Markdown files in /.kiro/.

issues.title: Enforce secret redaction, clean error formatter and GitHub identity pre push check
issues.problem: Failure ledger entries, terminal stack traces, or git commits can accidentally expose Bearer tokens, API query secrets, or secondary emails.
issues.desiredBehavior: All error serializers scrub secret tokens/URLs cleanly, support numeric --public-errors codes, and git hooks verify harrymove-ctrl identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Scrub Authorization headers, Bearer strings, URLs, query parameters, and secret JSON keys.
Support --public-errors returning numeric status codes without raw error strings.
Run git pre push author check cleanly before every commit and push.
issues.verification: Regex fuzz unit test asserts zero plaintext secrets survive redaction.

epics.title: Durable Local SQLite FTS5 Vault & 0600 Credential Layer
epics.summary: Build the DDIA style SQLite WAL append only vault, sub 15 ms FTS5 read layer, OS Keychain and ACL file credential resolver, SQL AST guard, and single writer lock.

issues.title: Implement SQLite WAL event sourced schema with FTS5 and derived projections
issues.problem: Repeated Discord API calls take seconds per query and risk HTTP 429 bans; local derived projections enable millisecond queries.
issues.desiredBehavior: Pure Go SQLite WAL schema persists immutable events and derived messages/FTS5/signals tables rebuildable from scratch at 0600 permissions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create events, messages, message_fts, channels, members, signal_clusters, drafts, and outbound_ledger tables.
Implement echoloom storage verify and echoloom storage rebuild commands.
Enforce 0700 directory permissions and 0600 SQLite database file permissions.
issues.verification: Benchmark measures < 15 ms p95 FTS5 query latency across 50,000 synthetic messages.

issues.title: Build macOS Keychain + O_NOFOLLOW descriptor bound file credential resolver
issues.problem: Storing bot tokens in plain config files or shell history invites accidental leaks or symlink/ACL bypasses on shared systems.
issues.desiredBehavior: Credential resolver prioritizes OS Keychain (echoloom), then env, then descriptor verified 0600 file reads with macOS extended ACL checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Support keyring, env, and file sources with macOS Keychain lookup prioritized.
Verify O_NOFOLLOW walk from root, 0600 file mode, 0700 parent dir, Nlink == 1, and ACL inspection.
Reject non Bot formatted tokens with explicit user guidance.
issues.verification: Integration test confirms symlinked or group readable token files fail with deterministic error.

issues.title: Harden read only SQLite query URI escaping and single statement AST guard
issues.problem: Raw file:%s?mode=ro DSN formatting breaks on paths with ? or #, and permitting leading PRAGMA statements allows multi statement ATTACH bypasses.
issues.desiredBehavior: Read only SQL execution URL escapes DB path cleanly, parses strictly single SELECT/WITH/EXPLAIN statements, and filters @me rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Encode database paths cleanly with net/url before opening read only connections.
Reject stacked statements, PRAGMA writes, and ATTACH DATABASE invocations.
Filter guild_id != '@me' in default read only query execution.
issues.verification: Unit tests block PRAGMA query_only=0; ATTACH and special character path injection inputs.

issues.title: Add single writer file lock and secret scrubbing subprocess wrapper
issues.problem: Concurrent sync and MCP background jobs risk SQLite lock races, and external helpers inherit sensitive parent environment variables unless stripped.
issues.desiredBehavior: Acquire non blocking O_NOFOLLOW Flock on sync.lock and strip secrets before invoking optional local helper subprocesses.
acceptanceCriteria: Use unix.Open(..., O_NOFOLLOW) and Flock LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB for single writer locking.
Strip DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY, and ECHOLOOM_* secrets from subprocess env slices.
Exit cleanly with descriptive error when another writer holds the lock.
issues.verification: Concurrency test proves second concurrent writer fails fast without database corruption.

epics.title: Tier 1 Official Discord Bot Sync, Scope & Live Gateway Tail
epics.summary: Deliver official Bot REST and Gateway ingestion locked down to specific owned channels with fixed CDN SSRF allowlisting on attachments.

issues.title: Implement official Bot REST client, echoloom init, and echoloom doctor
issues.problem: Bot onboarding needs instant feedback on Privileged Gateway Intents, guild pinning, and safe configuration defaults.
issues.desiredBehavior: init generates hardened config.toml defaulting sync.source to discord and attachment_text to false; doctor verifies live Bot intent and store health.
acceptanceCriteria: Explicitly prepend Bot prefix and mute third party transport logs carrying URLs.
Pin --guild in guild_ids cleanly instead of silently dumping every joined server.
Report actionable checks in echoloom doctor for Message Content Intent and SQLite health.
issues.verification: Mock Discord API test confirms doctor accurately catches missing intents and invalid tokens.

issues.title: Build backfill sync with --channels, category inclusion and thread expansion
issues.problem: Personal setups typically want one specific channel or support forum archived rather than ingesting an entire Discord server.
issues.desiredBehavior: sync paginates message history scoped to --channels or include_category_ids, auto expands forum threads, and saves durable cursors.
acceptanceCriteria: Support --channels ID list, --full history backfill, and --include-stored-threads.
Auto expand forum and media channel IDs to archived and active threads.
Respect Discord rate limit Retry-After headers without blind retry storms.
issues.verification: Unit suite proves excluded sibling channels persist zero messages during sync.

issues.title: Implement live Gateway tail honoring channel permissions and runtime scope filters
issues.problem: Owned servers need low latency updates for new questions, edits, and deletions without exceeding scope.
issues.desiredBehavior: Gateway tail records MESSAGE_CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE into events while strictly honoring include_category_ids and exclude_channel_ids.
acceptanceCriteria: Persist live message events and soft deletion timestamps accurately.
Drop gateway dispatches outside configured category/channel exclusions before SQLite writes.
Scrub gateway session endpoints from failure logs.
issues.verification: Mock gateway stream test verifies real time indexing and out of scope message rejection.

issues.title: Enforce strict HTTPS Discord CDN allowlist on attachment media and text fetches
issues.problem: Default text attachment fetching without host and redirect verification permits SSRF against internal or cloud metadata URLs.
issues.desiredBehavior: Unified attachment fetcher validates https port 443 and Discord CDN hostnames across every redirect hop before downloading bounded payloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Allow strictly https:// port 443 to cdn.discordapp.com, media.discordapp.net, or images-ext-<digits>.discordapp.net.
Reject IP literals, loopback addresses, userinfo credentials, and redirects leaving the allowlist.
Bound text attachment reads to 8 KiB and media downloads to 100 MiB.
issues.verification: PBT 1 fuzzes 1,000 SSRF/redirect URL payloads with zero bypasses.

epics.title: Tier 2 & Tier 3 Non Owned Channel Ingestion & @me Quarantine
epics.summary: Enable compliant zero selfbot ingestion of external Discord channels the user does not administer, via passive disk cache wiretap and read only browser DOM snapshots.

issues.title: Build zero network desktop cache wiretap reader using traversal safe os.OpenRoot
issues.problem: Users want to monitor external Discord servers without admin rights and without triggering ToS bans from user token selfbots.
issues.desiredBehavior: wiretap scans Discord Desktop local cache via os.OpenRoot with zero network calls, zero auth token reading, and zero raw blob persistence.
acceptanceCriteria: Read macOS Discord cache roots safely via Go os.OpenRoot (O_NOFOLLOW).
Exclude LevelDB authentication/token keys strictly from file traversal.
Verify zero outbound sockets opened during wiretap execution.
issues.verification: Offline test suite imports synthetic Discord Desktop cache fixtures with network disabled.

issues.title: Enforce strict @me personal DM quarantine across wiretap, search, and signals
issues.problem: Local Discord caches contain private DMs (@me) alongside community channels and must never bleed into content research or MCP outputs.
issues.desiredBehavior: Tag or skip @me messages on ingest and block private DM rows across default search, signal clusters, exports, and MCP handlers.
acceptanceCriteria: Skip @me DM records during external wiretap runs by default.
Set collection_scope = 'private_dm' if explicitly imported into an isolated vault.
Enforce guild_id != '@me' filters in all search, signal, export, and MCP queries.
issues.verification: PBT 2 generates 1,000 interleaved @me and guild datasets asserting 0 DM rows leak.

issues.title: Build OpenCLI & Chrome DevTools MCP take_snapshot Discord tab parser
issues.problem: Viewing older external threads in Chrome Web gives cleaner DOM visibility than Chromium disk caches without using browser tokens.
issues.desiredBehavior: Snapshot importer ingests accessibility DOM JSON from opencli browser or chrome-devtools take_snapshot into normalized SQLite rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse Discord Web channel header, message authors, timestamps, replies, and bodies cleanly.
Never query localStorage, document.cookie, or Discord gateway auth frames.
Tag every parsed row with source_tier = 'browser_snapshot'.
issues.verification: DOM snapshot fixture tests extract multi participant thread sequences with zero token reads.

issues.title: Implement cross tier bot_api + wiretap + browser_snapshot deduplication
issues.problem: Archiving the same external channel via wiretap and browser snapshot must not double count questions or pollute clusters.
issues.desiredBehavior: Cross tier upsert reconciles Discord message snowflakes and normalized content hashes idempotently while upgrading incomplete metadata safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Deduplicate on exact message snowflake ID when available across tiers.
Fall back to deterministic (channel_id, minute_bucket, author_hash, content_sha256) key.
Preserve higher fidelity bot_api metadata if ingested after cache or snapshot runs.
issues.verification: PBT 5 replays 1,000 shuffled cross tier ingest sequences confirming exact row counts.

epics.title: discord-cli Analytics Surface & Anonymized Signal Radar
epics.summary: Deliver fast jackwener/discord-cli terminal analytics, deterministic JSON/YAML contracts, external PII scrubbing, and actionable content topic clustering.

issues.title: Implement today, recent, search, stats, top, timeline, export, and purge commands
issues.problem: Users and coding agents need rich analytics commands beyond raw SQL queries.
issues.desiredBehavior: CLI implements the complete discord-cli command suite scoped cleanly by channel ID or unambiguous channel name.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement today, recent, search, stats, top, timeline (--by hour|day), export, and purge.
Stop with channel_resolution_error listing matching channel IDs when name is ambiguous.
Exclude private_dm and soft deleted rows from analytical rollups.
issues.verification: CLI golden tests verify each analytics command completes under 20 ms on local SQLite.

issues.title: Implement deterministic SCHEMA.md JSON / YAML output envelope
issues.problem: Downstream scripts and Kiro agents break when CLI stdout mixes logs with inconsistent table text.
issues.desiredBehavior: Structured formatter emits uniform { ok, schema_version: '1', data | error } JSON or YAML output while routing logs to stderr.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto switch non TTY stdout to YAML unless --json or --format rich is passed.
Include actionable error codes and recovery hints in failure envelopes.
Guarantee zero diagnostic log lines appear on stdout.
issues.verification: Output schema parser validates every CLI command in both --json and --yaml modes.

issues.title: Build PII & username anonymizer for desktop_wiretap and browser_snapshot rows
issues.problem: Synthesizing content from external Discord communities must never expose external member usernames, IDs, or private contact info.
issues.desiredBehavior: Deterministic anonymizer strips mentions, handles, IDs, emails, and IPs, replacing speakers with ephemeral session aliases before clustering.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace user handles and mentions with session scoped labels (Participant_A, Participant_B).
Scrub email addresses, phone patterns, Discord snowflakes, and secret query tokens.
Enforce mandatory anonymization gate on wiretap and browser_snapshot text before MCP or LLM access.
issues.verification: Adversarial fixture tests confirm zero handles, emails, or numeric Discord IDs survive.

issues.title: Implement echoloom signals topic clusterer and opportunity ranker
issues.problem: High volume chat channels make it hard to spot which bugs or questions deserve a dedicated tutorial post on your own server.
issues.desiredBehavior: signals groups anonymized discussions into ranked buckets (unanswered_question, recurring_bug, feature_gap, high_engagement_topic).
acceptanceCriteria: Rank clusters by frequency, unique anonymized participant count, and recency.
Output concise structured briefs ready for Voice Composer drafting.
Support time window filters (--hours, --days) and guild/channel isolation.
issues.verification: Deterministic clustering test extracts expected top 3 topics from seeded developer chat fixtures.

epics.title: VoiceGate Content Studio, stdio MCP Server & confirmLive Governor
epics.summary: Build ListeningKit inspired voiceGate style checks, AI slop rejection, hot reloading stdio MCP tools, SQLite claim locks, and dry run confirmLive write protection.

issues.title: Build owner writing profile extractor (echoloom voice index)
issues.problem: Agent drafted Discord posts sound generic unless grounded in the owner's actual cadence and technical formatting habits.
issues.desiredBehavior: voice index builds a local style fingerprint strictly from the owner's own authored messages in owned servers.
acceptanceCriteria: Restrict training corpus exclusively to --owner-id messages inside owned channels.
Compute sentence length bands, code block ratio, greeting patterns, and preferred terminology.
Persist style profile locally in SQLite without external API transmission.
issues.verification: Profile test produces deterministic style vector from fixture owner post corpus.

issues.title: Implement voiceGate, watermarkReadingOf AI slop blocker and overlap detector
issues.problem: Drafts can accidentally retain hidden LLM Unicode characters, cliché prose phrases, or copy too closely from external source questions.
issues.desiredBehavior: voiceGate rejects hidden artifacts, AI dash punctuation, and > 12 word source overlaps before any outbound draft can enter approved state.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect and fail aiArtifacts for zero width spaces, em/en dashes, spaced hyphens, and pasted HTML.
Reject drafts exceeding 12 consecutive word n gram overlap with any external ingested message (plagiarismRisk).
Return exact violation codes, offsets, and actionable rewrite hints.
issues.verification: PBT 3 injects slop glyphs and verbatim source spans across 1,000 runs expecting 100% rejection.

issues.title: Build hot reloading stdio MCP server (echoloom-mcp) with play discovery
issues.problem: AI coding assistants need a unified stdio MCP bridge with live reload and multi agent claim locks so agents never duplicate replies.
issues.desiredBehavior: echoloom-mcp serves play guides, signal reads, voiceGate checks, dry run previews, and claim locked writes cleanly over stdio.
acceptanceCriteria: Expose get_play_guide, search_signals, get_channel_context, score_voice_gate, preview_outbound, and publish_approved.
Emit tools/list_changed cleanly when updated on disk between active jobs.
Enforce SQLite claim locks preventing two agents from claiming the same cluster simultaneously.
issues.verification: MCP stdio integration harness executes complete discovery -> draft -> claim -> preview sequence.

issues.title: Implement confirmLive outbound safety governor, rate cap and digest scheduler
issues.problem: Autonomous agents with live posting credentials can spam owned Discord channels if approval gates or rate caps can be bypassed.
issues.desiredBehavior: Governor enforces dry run previews by default, requires live + confirmLive + approvedBy, limits sends per day, and compiles morning briefings.
acceptanceCriteria: Return non mutating diff preview unless live: true, confirmLive: true, and non empty approvedBy are passed.
Enforce >= 5s inter message delay, 25/day channel cap, immediate halt on HTTP 429, and outbound_ledger audit rows.
Generate echoloom digest --hours 24 daily signal and draft briefing.
issues.verification: PBT 4 fuzzes 1,000 malformed flag combinations proving 0 unapproved write executions.

epics.title: Haunted Signal Ops Web Console & Playwright Visual & Accessibility QA
epics.summary: Build the local loopback web ops dashboard displaying anonymized clusters, voiceGate diffs, outbound audit timelines, and confirmLive dialogs verified by Playwright.

issues.title: Build loopback bound Haunted Signal Loom web console (127.0.0.1 + CSRF)
issues.problem: Human operators reviewing multiple anonymized clusters and pending drafts benefit from a crisp local UI alongside terminal MCP workflows.
issues.desiredBehavior: Web console binds strictly to loopback 127.0.0.1, requires per session CSRF tokens on mutations, and renders responsive Haunted Signal Loom views.
acceptanceCriteria: Reject non loopback listen addresses and validate CSRF headers on every state changing endpoint.
Render source tier badges (bot_api, wiretap, browser_snapshot) and voiceGate diagnostic chips.
Operate cleanly at both 1280x800 desktop and 390x844 mobile viewports without clipping.
issues.verification: Server security test verifies unauthenticated POST fails with 403 and responsive layout renders clean.

issues.title: Build outbound audit ledger timeline and two step approval drawer
issues.problem: Operators reviewing queued drafts need full visibility into outbound receipts, cooldown windows, and explicit two step confirmation state.
issues.desiredBehavior: Render filterable outbound_ledger events alongside an accessible two step approval drawer inspecting voiceGate diffs and approval receipts.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter outbound_ledger events cleanly by publish status and target owned channel inside Haunted Signal Loom.
Inspect voiceGate scores, cooldown state, and approval receipt hashes prior to confirmation.
Require explicit confirmation dialog click before calling approveDraft endpoint with keyboard focus management and ARIA status.
issues.verification: Playwright test steps through keyboard navigation, modal confirmation, and ledger filtering cleanly.

issues.title: Run Playwright Visual & Accessibility QA via chrome-devtools MCP + live screenshot proof
issues.problem: Visual polish, contrast compliance, zero horizontal scrollbars, and error states must be proven in a real headless Chromium browser.
issues.desiredBehavior: Run automated Playwright + Chrome DevTools accessibility checks across every state and capture before/after screenshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Pass contrast, overflow, console error zeroing, and state machine transition checks across all interactive states.
Save deterministic 1280x800 desktop and 390x844 mobile screenshots under docs/visual-proof/.
Complete 4,000 Free Kiro Credits request before December 1 cutoff.
issues.verification: Visual QA runner exits 0 across desktop and mobile viewports with zero a11y/layout errors.

epics.title: Property Based Testing, Deployment, Video & Kiroween Ship
epics.summary: Finalize 5 generative PBT invariant suites, prove end to end 4 agent Kiro Crew execution, deploy live public demo showcase, record the < 3:00 video, and submit on Devpost.

issues.title: Complete all 5 PBT suites (1,000+ runs each) and wire Kiro Crew end to end run
issues.problem: Kiroween judges look closely for nontrivial invariants discovered via Property Based Testing rather than trivial unit tests alone.
issues.desiredBehavior: All 5 generative PBT suites execute >= 1,000 iterations each across CI and Kiro hooks, alongside verified 4 agent Kiro Crew workflow logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Pass PBT 1 (SSRF), PBT 2 (@me isolation), PBT 3 (voiceGate slop & overlap), PBT 4 (confirmLive governor), and PBT 5 (idempotent dedup).
Execute full Kiro Crew 4 role workflow trace with zero bypassed gates.
Document real edge cases surfaced by PBT for section 7 of the Devpost write up.
issues.verification: Full test suite passes all 5 PBT suites (>= 5,000 total fuzz cases) in CI under 15 seconds.

issues.title: Deploy live demo URL, film < 3:00 YouTube video, and finalize Devpost submission
issues.problem: Missing the < 3:00 YouTube cap, live app link, public MIT repo /.kiro check, or 8 section Kiro write up causes immediate Devpost disqualification.
issues.desiredBehavior: Live demo app, public YouTube video (< 3:00), public GitHub repo (harrymove-ctrl), bonus blog/social posts, and complete 8 part write up ship before deadline.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify live deployed interactive demo URL with clean read only sample dataset.
Publish < 3:00 public YouTube demo video using original non copyrighted audio.
Publish #KiroweenHackathon26 Social Blitz post, Bonus Blog post, and submit Devpost entry before Dec 4 2:00 PM PST.
issues.verification: Pre submission audit script verifies LICENSE, committed /.kiro, PBT pass, video length < 180s, and live URL HTTP 200.
